chapter: The band, its players and singers
title: Size of the band when it came to New York
summary: Basie says he wanted a full brass section, started with four reeds and two tenors, and later added another alto.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x:
Well, I am glad you remind me anyway.
Okay, Fletcher had what, three trumpets, three saxophones, Fletcher Henderson. I am switching now.
He had -- three sax-es or four sax-es

He had four trumpets, -- three trumpets, four saxophones, three trombones, guitar, piano, drums, bass. But you had more. Did you have more than that when you had the original -- well, not the original, the band you brought to New York. Was it more or less because I was never able to get that.
Let's see, he had, according to this, 14 -- you had 16, didn't you? You have now 16.
I don't think I had but -- is that three trumpets or four trumpets, when I first came to New York.
Three or four trumpets. let me ask you this:
When you did come to -- when you did decide how many you wanted, how did you make that decision? How did you decide how many horns you wanted.

I just wanted to hear a full brass section, what I consider full brass section, be eight brass and like reed -- I don't think I came -- what did I come in here with. We had two tenors -- I think we just had four reeds. I don't think I had five reeds.
Yeah, then later we added on another alto. We added on another alto, we came with two altos and -- we had one alto-baritone, we had two tenors and so we just added on.
